assertions.name: div25_q_deformation_test_decisive
assertions.source: DECISIVE <=> exactly one of the two candidates lies within 10x the better |eps_ppm| against the cal-anchored c_3 target. Here /25 gives +2.651 ppm and /[5]_q^2 gives -982.245 ppm — a separation of 370.5x, so the leading band holds 1 candidate. Two comparable candidates would give 2 and turn this red, which is exactly the outcome the old computed=1/expected=1 could not report. WHICH candidate wins is in `verdict`; this assertion is about the comparison being separable at all.

description: Test the audit-doc conjecture /25 = (T(2,5) framing)². Compares the q-undeformed /25 c_3 closure (current main) to a q-deformed /[5]_q² candidate. If the q-deformation gives a worse c_3 fit, /25 is not a framing² in the categorical sense (it does not deform with q).

candidate_categorical_25_at_q_1.note: All four reduce to 25 at q=1; they DIFFER away from q=1.

verdict.conclusion: /25 in c_3 closure is q-undeformed empirical constant; q-deformation /[5]_q² gives WORSE precision. /25 is NOT a categorical framing² that deforms with q. The structural source remains OPEN (classical-limit framing, integer-denominator Habiro element, or unreduced Markov normalization at 5 strands).
